Controls printed by the original game: X turns the rocket clockwise; Z turns it counterclockwise; Space moves it forward; Enter fires its laser. At the opening, press any key, then enter Y and Return to start.

Fuse 48K at 150% speed: wait 0.7 seconds, press Enter for 0.08 seconds, wait 0.4 seconds, then press Y and Enter. Wait 0.7 seconds for the game view. Press X, Space, Enter and Z in that order, each held 0.08 seconds with a 0.15-second release and another 0.1-second wait. Screenshots record the game before and after the actions. Moving meteors can also alter the screen independently of the player's keys.
